meta.name: Love in the Moonlight
meta.description:
A young Joseon woman who's lived her whole life as a man ends up as a eunuch in the royal palace, where she begins to bond with the crown prince.

Complete series. On your server: S1 18/18

videos.title: Moonlight Destiny
videos.overview: To everyone else in town, Hong Sam-nom is known as a man who'll do anything for money. But to his adoptive father, he's known by a different name.

videos.title: The Way to Your Heart
videos.overview: As the other eunuch trainees try their best to pass the three exams, Sam-nom tries her best to fail, but someone wants to make sure she stays.

videos.title: I Will Be Right Behind
videos.overview: Sam-nom is stunned when she sees her exam result for her blank answer sheet. The king's mental state is becoming increasingly unstable.

videos.title: After the Play Has Ended
videos.overview: At the king's upcoming birthday banquet, the crown prince plans to seek permission for regency from the Qing envoy, who's notoriously hard to please.

videos.title: Tell Me Your Wish
videos.overview: No one can identify or locate the mysterious woman who performed the solo dance. Sam-nom requests permission to attend the Lantern Festival.

videos.title: When You Want to Say Unspeakable Secret
videos.overview: The crown prince's attitude toward Sam-nom completely changes. Eunuch Ma tells the Qing envoy that he can bring what the envoy desires most in Joseon.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: A rumor spreads in the palace that the crown prince doesn't like women. Another rumor says that eunuchs and court ladies are carrying on affairs.

videos.title: Although You Don't Know Well
videos.overview: For Sam-nom, the crown prince's confession is bittersweet. The crown prince and Premier Kim butt heads regarding the national civil service exams.

videos.title: Latch Opening Moment of the Heart
videos.overview: Sam-nom starts avoiding the crown prince's palace. The crown prince finds her at Royal Consort Park's residence, where Princess Yeongeun has gone missing.

videos.title: Like a Fairy Tale
videos.overview: As political unrest grips the capital, the king decides to hasten the crown prince's marriage with a candidate he already has in mind.

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: The crown prince defends the young girl who's accused of treason, but poison discovered in the king's meal gets linked back to the girl's father.

videos.title: Trust Becomes Your Destiny Itself
videos.overview: Ra-on's mother is alarmed by what Ra-on has been doing. The crown prince finds evidence of corruption committed by a minister from the Kim family.

videos.title: Fondly, All the Best
videos.overview: Realizing the danger of her staying in the palace, Ra-on secretly prepares to leave. The crown prince orders a search for the attacker who escaped.

videos.title: Misty Road
videos.overview: The crown prince is deeply affected by Ra-on's absence. The chief eunuch reminds Byeong-yeon where Ra-on needs to be. The queen gives birth to a baby.

videos.title: All the Lies Seemed True
videos.overview: The crown prince wishes to know what Ra-on's true intentions really were. The chief eunuch senses that there's a traitor within the Baekwoon Group.

videos.title: The World That You Dream Of
videos.overview: The news of Hong Gyeong-rae's return shocks everyone. Even while putting her life at risk, Ra-on wishes to reenter the palace to meet her father.

videos.title: The End for the Beginning
videos.overview: One month after the chaos at Hong Gyeong-rae's interrogation, Premier Kim notifies the queen that her baby boy will soon become the crown prince.

videos.title: Moonlight Drawn by Clouds
videos.overview: Jeong Yak-yong gets summoned to the palace to treat the crown prince, and Ra-on follows in disguise. Rumor has it that the crown prince is dying.

meta.slogan: The unlikely love story between a crown prince and his eunuch.
